culprit.$example: Teardown ordering violated: prod removal requires the final backup push verified before deletion; the last verified backup is stale and prod mutated since.

measured.$example: last verified backup: 6d ago (snap_prod_daily_047); prod ops since: 3

component.remedy: run 'capcli sys backup --push' to land and verify the final backup, then re-run 'capcli env remove prod' (the out-of-band challenge signature gate still applies). If the push is rejected, the sys.backup.denial.push_fail remedy applies: refresh vault credentials via 'capcli sys vault import-env' or 'capcli sys vault set <key> <val>', reconcile the remotes, then retry the push

lines.$example: Teardown ordering violated: backup first, revoke identities second,
dump state third, remove envs last. The final prod backup push
is unverified; deletion is refused until it lands.
